title: [LangFuzz] Crash on heap with invalid write (32 bit only).
description_snippet:
**VULNERABILITY DETAILS**   
The JavaScript code below crashes Chromium 19.0.1084.15 dev and d8 shell (trunk revision 11244) on heap with an invalid write to a strange address. The address is not fixed, I have multiple tests that crash at different addresses so I assume it can be controlled somehow.
